notes.title: Wermwood Demo v1.0.3 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600156/22c7242bd27f6a5452b1696d4cf08542e5f866b3.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated title screen graphics.
[*] Added Credits after final boss.
[*] Increased the healing amount of all Consumable Items.
[*] Added new enemy drops for increased item diversity!
[*] Changed first chest to Uber Coffee item and new dialogue.
[*] Updated in-battle fonts and font styles for visual clarity and cohesiveness.
[*] Updated pause menu UI visuals.
[*] Added message complete indicator (yellow downwards arrow icon) to dialogue.
[*] Increasing damage of various enemy skills.
[*] Staggering enemy positioning in multi-matchups.
[/list]

[h2]Feature Update - Digidec[/h2]
[list]
[*] Digidec item can be found in Pause Menu > Items > Key.
[*] When using the Digidec item, you are prompted to provide a 3-digit number.
[*] Several numbers have been integrated for testing or emergency purposes:
[list]
[*] “666” - Teleports you to the starting area.
[*]  “777” - Grants consumables.
[*] “888” - Grants modules and seals.
[*] “999” - Grants credits.[/list]
[*] Please Note: This feature is intended to get you out of a pinch, these codes will mess with intended difficulty + progression.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed text sharpening effect that was causing occasional lag spikes and making some fonts hard to read.
[*] Fixed multiple issues with Party status after defeating final boss.
[*] Added extra fencing in starting area to prevent players from getting stuck inside the Mailbox after cutscene.
[*] Fixed various shrooms causing no-clipping.
[*] Fixed issue where using the Digidec caused music to disappear after use.
[*] Fixed missing animation in Snail cutscene.
[*] Fixed various grammatical dialogue errors.
[*] Fixed issue where Puffballs in starting area would interfere with cutscenes.
[*] Disabled party formation changing. Clancy is always party leader.
[*] Various chests no longer disappear while being opened.
[/list]
